ig_caption:
Someone deleted prod. Nobody knew how it was built. 😶 (Infrastructure as Code fixes this)

Our AI chatbot setup was made by hand:
⚠️ a registry, a network, the chatbot, from docker commands typed months ago on someone's laptop
⚠️ nothing written down

Someone "cleaned up" → DOWN. No way back, only memory and guesses.

The fix: Terraform.
✅ the whole setup as code, in Git
✅ every piece, every port, every setting

From nothing → one terraform apply → back in seconds, exactly as before.

If it's not in code, it doesn't exist.

Share this with your infra team 🔁 Follow to see this chatbot reach production 🚀

#terraform #iac #devops #infrastructureascode #ai
yt_title: Rebuild deleted prod in seconds with Terraform #terraform
yt_description:
Real run (Terraform + Docker provider, local):
- the setup (network, registry, chatbot) was created by hand; after "docker rm -f" there is nothing to rebuild from
- the same setup as Terraform code: from an empty state, one terraform apply recreates 3 resources and the chatbot answers again

Infrastructure as Code: if it's not in code, it doesn't exist.

Part of the "AI App to Production" journey: one AI chatbot from laptop to production. Follow along.
